name: desktop-test-preview-isolation
goal: Ordinary Desktop browser tests start their own preview on a dedicated port and refuse an existing server; the native test opens Designs before viewing a design

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Full check at 4a92aed: native-desktop.spec.ts:79 looked for a design on the Overview an entity now opens with; the ordinary run reused another checkout's server on 5799 (PID 57111). Expected: the test selects Designs; an ordinary run owns its preview and refuses an existing server. Diagnosis: work/runtime-evidence-review/frozen-e2e-failure/report.md

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Native: byte-identical copy of the unchanged spec (sha 5cf79081) fails at :79, heading 'No design image yet' not found (native-RED-unchanged-spec.log). Guard test/test-preview-refusal.test.ts (sha 3c492a76) on the unchanged config (sha 6c2d5168) in a throwaway copy: 4 tests ran on the existing 5799 server, no refusal; 1 failed (guard-RED-unchanged-config.log). Logs in work/runtime-evidence-review/test-preview-isolation

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: native-desktop.spec.ts: one selection of Designs in Entity sections after Create plan; 1 test and 22 assertions before and after. playwright.config.ts: ordinary runs start 'bun run dev --port 5796', reuseExistingServer false, HARNESS_DESKTOP_TEST_PORT validated 1024-65535. Verification branch resolves identically (verify-branch-unchanged.log). README line; no product source, hosted spec, static server or package.json change

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same guard file: 2 passed (guard-GREEN.log). TAKE_SCREENSHOT=true native-desktop.spec.ts: 1 passed, four inspected screenshots show Designs selected (native-screens, SHA256SUMS). Focused native + ui-hosted on the owned 5796 preview: 5 passed. bun run test:e2e: 61 passed, exit 0 (desktop-e2e-full.log). 5796 released after each run; 5799 PID 57111 untouched

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Prove that reintroducing server reuse makes the guard fail, and that the repaired configuration passes it.
steps.evidence: Throwaway copy with reuseExistingServer true: the guard fails, a HeadlessChrome request reached its foreign server (guard-MUTANT-reuse-true.log). Repaired tree: 2 passed. Observed directly: foreign page refused as 'already used' with only Playwright's probe seen; held port answering 404 stops Vite by strictPort; override 5796x refused by name (refusal-*.log)
